channel.title: Harbour Notes
channel.description: Small news from a small harbour.

item.title: Tom & Jerry’s new ferry
item.dc:creator: Ada Brightwater
item.content:encoded:
The new ferry arrives in spring, painted the same blue as the old one.

Its crew of four has already practised the crossing twice.

item.title: Lamps lit early
item.description: The harbour master lit the lamps an hour early because of fog.

item.title: Undated notice
item.description: The slipway is closed on Thursdays.
